evidence: Arithmetic on committed products, one-dimensional gaseous absorption (ITU-R P.676-13 Annex 1, the power screen's model, reproduced against ITU-R Study Group 3's Earth values) through prescribed clear-sky columns, and means of the design run's own sunlight, cloud and winds. Published values are labelled with their sources and how far each was read; recalled values, estimates and design guesses are labelled as such. No plant, store, beam, grid or line is designed or simulated, and nothing here is validated against a built system.
reading_rule: Pairs are [low-cost end, high-cost end] of C' with the food blend, as the domain synthesis gives them; where an option's own range is wide its low end goes with the low-cost loads and its high end with the high-cost loads, so a pair spans both. 'Per TW' means per terawatt delivered to the loads. Heat is what the option leaves on the Moon beyond the sunlight it would have absorbed anyway, at an efficacy of 1 as the climate targets take it; a point of dimming is 1% of the hot world's absorbed sunlight, 225.4 W/m2. Land in km2; storage in TWh delivered; masses in Mt or Gt.

collector_conversion.basis: the climate targets' and heat-levers study's 20-30% for collectors on dimmed light

rectenna_peak_w_m2.basis: the 1978 reference's peak, as the synthesis fills the ground's patches

receiver_buffer.basis: the power screen's ground closed round each patch to the public 10 W/m2, a quarter more

rectenna_areal_kg_m2.basis: a ground rectenna of mesh, dipoles and footings; the 1978 reference used steel panels on continuous concrete footings, not quantified here

sps_kg_per_kw.basis: the 1978 reference satellite, about 5e4 t for 5 GW delivered (OTA 1981 summary, from a search snippet; not read in full); thin-film tiles would be lighter

line_raised.basis: a raised receiver: conductor down its tether and a converter, 2-3% in all

raised_heights_km.basis: above the storms (tops 22 km, the 0 C level 27-28 km) and the reefs

pv_module.basis: 22%: commercial wafer modules from 2024 production (Fraunhofer ISE Photovoltaics Report 2025); 30%: an estimate for commercial tandem modules

pv_derate.basis: temperature, inverter, wiring and soiling together

pv_tilt_gain.basis: tilting or tracking against a flat panel, small in the deep air's diffuse light

ground_cover_ratio.basis: panel area over the land a plant occupies

pv_albedo.basis: glass-faced modules with their frames and gaps

cloud_reflect_up.basis: the share of light reflected up from the ground that a cloud above sends back down

surface_kernel_clear.basis: the heat-levers study's clear-sky kernel at the equator: the Moon reflects 0.34 more of the arriving sunlight for each unit of surface albedo

pv_t_per_mwp.basis: modules about 55 t/MWp (Mirletz et al. 2022: 97 Mt for 1.75 TW), mounting steel 60-67 t/MWp and aluminium 6-8 t/MWp (search summaries); Earth mounting, lighter at a sixth g

hydrogen_round_trip.basis: Headley & Schoenung 2020, in the power screen

fuel_cell.basis: the power screen's electricity per unit of hydrogen's heating value

hydrogen_store_density.basis: kg/m3 of hydrogen near 20 MPa and 300 K

battery_kwh_kg.basis: the power screen's pack specific energy

iron_air_round_trip.basis: Form Energy target for its 100-hour iron-air system (secondary sources)

grid_long_loss.basis: the first screen: HVDC 2-3.5% per 1,000 km and 1% a converter over 4,000-5,500 km (US EIA 2018)

grid_line_gw.basis: Changji-Guquan, 1,100 kV, 12 GW over more than 3,000 km (Hitachi Energy; in sources.json)

grid_distance_km.basis: the first screen's distances to the day side

grid_al_t_per_km.basis: aluminium for both poles of a 12 GW line at 1,100 kV losing 2.5% per 1,000 km

roof_usable_share.basis: share of roofs and pavements that carries panels

grid_peak_transfer.basis: the share of the ground's load the lines carry at once, the night side's loads with C''s far-side lean

aerial_transmission.basis: sunlight reaching panels 30 km up, above the cloud and most of the vapour

aerial_albedo_below.basis: the design run's planetary albedo (high-cloud product), what panels above the cloud cover

aerial_escape.basis: share of light reflected at 30 km that leaves the air

laser_wall_plug.basis: fibre lasers above 50% (IPG) and diode lasers to 71% at 780 nm (2023)

laser_capture.basis: beam spread and the dense air's turbulence

laser_cell.basis: 68.9% for a GaAs cell under 858 nm laser light (Fraunhofer ISE 2021), about 20% laser-to-electric at the receiver in the 2025 DARPA POWER record; arrays at high flux between them

rayleigh_earth_850nm.basis: Earth's Rayleigh optical depth at 850 nm

rayleigh_earth_550nm.basis: Earth's Rayleigh optical depth at 550 nm

optical_other_depth.basis: water vapour's window absorption and aerosol in the deep, moist column

optical_escape.basis: share of the light lost from the beam that leaves the Moon instead of warming it

rx_5_8.basis: the 2.45 GHz chain kept at 5.8 GHz; 82% is published for a 5.8 GHz rectenna, 90.6% for Brown 1977 at 2.45 GHz

thorium_ppm.basis: Procellarum KREEP Terrane, Lunar Prospector (Lawrence et al.; search summaries)

heat_flow_mw_m2.basis: Apollo 15 and 17 (Langseth et al. 1976); Siegler & Smrekar 2014 put the internal flow at 9-13 mW/m2

otec_w_m2.basis: Earth's 7-14 TW (Rajagopalan & Nihous 2013) over about 3e14 m2 of warm ocean, carried to the Moon's seas by area alone; their deep water's temperature is open

hydro_developable.basis: share of the rivers' gross power a fleet of plants could take

earth_land_wind_power_density_w_m2.basis: the Global Wind Atlas's mean power density over its whole area and over the windiest half (Badger et al.; search summary)

moon_gust_factor.basis: instantaneous over 3-day-mean wind cubes; the design run's means lack the gusts

food_wet_kg.basis: a person-day shipped dry to fresh

phosphorus_kg_person_year.basis: README finding 11: the metropolis passes 44 kt of P a year for 100 million

computing_kept.basis: the power screen's millisecond control kept on the Moon

aloft_share.basis: C': 4 of the Moon's 8 billion aloft

loads.rule: the synthesis's array heat by component over the Earth-service 1.376 W a delivered watt; the towns take their control, hydrogen, trips and the aloft half of the residents

geometry.rule: variants carry the power screen's load-weighted ground loss by the ratio of losses at the ground beams' mean operating elevation (an estimate); pairs are [highest tiles, any tile above 30 degrees] and, for raised receivers, the better and worse line

air.rule: dB and share lost from each receiver height to the column top; the vapour share is the water lines and continuum over the whole path
